items.briefing:
New research from Commvault highlights a concerning trend: one in three organisations across Australia and New Zealand are still paying ransomware demands, despite this rarely guaranteeing data recovery. This comes as ransomware attacks on industrial sectors reached 1,140 incidents globally in the second quarter of 2026 alone. Separately, a NSW government audit has found that major agencies continue to repeat the same cybersecurity control failures year after year, suggesting systemic issues in how public sector organisations manage risk.

For everyday staff, these findings are a reminder that paying attackers doesn't make the problem go away — prevention is far more effective. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email or message asking you to open a file or click a link, verify the request directly with the sender before acting.

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, revealing critical vulnerability in regional cybersecurity posture.
